title: Starship reaches orbit, and what comes next
subtitle: Flight 14's first orbital trip, its new Starlink payload, and the road to Flight 15.
title_narration: Starship reaches orbit. And what comes next.
as_of: Grounded in Jim's Interest Journal research for Sep 28, Sep 29, Oct 5 and Oct 6, 2026. Flight 15 timing is unofficial.

scenes.label: Sep 28 · Flight 14
scenes.heading: The first Starship flight to reach *orbit*

events.label: One of six ship Raptors shuts down early

scenes.caption: On September 28, Starship Flight 14 lifted off from Starbase at 8:49 a.m. EDT, and became the first Starship flight to reach low Earth orbit, after 13 suborbital flights.
evidence: First Starship flight to reach **low Earth orbit** after 13 suborbital flights
One of Ship’s six Raptors shut down early on ascent

scenes.label: The payload
scenes.heading: Next-gen Starlinks, too big for Falcon 9

cards.label: each, too large for a Falcon 9 fairing

scenes.caption: It deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites, each about 2 tonnes and too large for a Falcon 9 fairing. SpaceX claims about 1 Tbps of capacity each.
evidence: too large for Falcon 9 fairing; ~2 t each; ~**1 Tbps** capacity each

scenes.label: Cut short on purpose
scenes.heading: Planned 10 hours, flew about 3
scenes.caption: The plan was about 10 hours and 6 orbits. Out of caution after the engine issue, the ship came down north of Hawaii about 3 hours after liftoff.
evidence: out of an abundance of caution
splashdown **11:57 a.m. EDT** (~3 h after liftoff)

scenes.label: Fueling the Cape
scenes.heading: SpaceX wants a methane pipeline

cards.label: natural gas pipeline proposed in Brevard County
line to fuel Starship from Cape Canaveral
similar line requested for Boca Chica

scenes.caption: To fuel Starship at Cape Canaveral, a SpaceX subsidiary wants a 32.4-mile, 16-inch natural gas pipeline, because trucked gas can't keep up. A similar 8-mile line is requested for Boca Chica.
evidence: seeking approval for a 32.4-mile, 16-inch natural gas pipeline in Brevard County
because trucked gas can't keep up
A similar 8-mile line has been requested for Boca Chica

scenes.label: What's next
scenes.heading: The road to a ship *catch*

events.label: Morgan Stanley: a catch could be the biggest catalyst since the IPO
Ship catch and orbital refueling demo

scenes.caption: Morgan Stanley says a ship catch on the next flight could be the biggest positive catalyst since the IPO. For Flight 15, the unofficial NET Oct 19 still stands.
evidence: a Starship ship catch on the next flight could be "the biggest positive catalyst since the IPO."
There's still no official date. The unofficial NET Oct 19 still stands.
Still ahead: orbital refueling demo + Ship RTLS/catch.
